shared_elements: bird or animal forms in profile
justification: The most specific overlap is the use of schematic profile creatures, including bird-like forms, alongside rows or bands of repeated signs. The major difference is that A is dominated by dense, orderly sign-text and small seated human figures in registers, while B is dominated by large isolated animal/body-part motifs on a pillar-like field with no comparable seated-figure-and-text scheme.
